summary: On the other side of the sea, Moses and the people sang a song of praise. Miriam picked up her tambourine, and all the women danced and sang, 'Sing to Yahweh!'

story_reel.narration: When God's people reached the other side of the sea and saw what God had done, they couldn't keep quiet! Moses and the Israelites sang a brand-new song to Yahweh: 'I will sing to Yahweh, for He has triumphed gloriously! The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea. Yah is my strength and my song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise Him!' Yah is a short way of saying Yahweh. They sang about how no one is like God, majestic in holiness, awesome in glory, doing wonders. They sang that God's unfailing love had led the people He rescued. Then Miriam, Moses' and Aaron's sister, picked up her tambourine. All the women followed her with tambourines and dancing! Miriam sang, 'Sing to Yahweh, for He has triumphed gloriously!' What a celebration! When God does something amazing in our lives, it's right to stop and praise Him, with singing, dancing, art, or a thankful heart.
